court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Kanpur Nagar - Case No. 932 of 2023
case_name: Smt. Monika Mishra vs Sri Parag Mishra
facts_of_case: Marriage solemnized on 08.09.2014; harassment for dowry and sent back to father in 07.11.2022; pending cases at Auraiya; seeking transfer from Kanpur Nagar to Auraiya.

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife must be looked into in matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: This Court has observed that in matrimonial cases, the convenience of the wife must be looked into;
cited_cases: Smt. Akansha Saxena v. Shikhar Saxena, (2026) 3 ADJ 104
Smt. Arju @ Vimal v. Umakant Parasar, (2026) 3 ADJ 66

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should be subserved in exercising power under Section 24 CPC.
legal_principles.held: the cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 CPC being that the ends of justice should be subserved;
cited_cases: Smt. Akansha Saxena v. Shikhar Saxena, (2026) 3 ADJ 104
Smt. Arju @ Vimal v. Umakant Parasar, (2026) 3 ADJ 66

outcome.final_order: Transfer of case allowed from Principal Judge, Family Court, Kanpur Nagar to Principal Judge, Family Court, Auraiya.

use_for_drafting: drafting transfer application in Family Court
advising on divorce proceedings in Kanpur Nagar
assisting with notice and stay orders
